title: Items with effects
sub: A “Weapon” type: a property, a “Strike” button for the owner and a modifier to armor class.
start: there is “Strike”: it is granted to all sheets and takes off 5 hit points by itself. There is no “Weapon” item type yet.

kind.title: Item type
kind.sum: There is a “Weapon” type, and “Strike” expects “Weapon damage” and is given by an item.

button.title: Button and modifier
button.sum: A weapon gives its owner “Strike” with its own damage and +1 to armor class.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You created an item type with a modifier without hints.

kind.lead: An item type is a common shape for all items of one kind. “Weapon” will have a property that the book author fills in for every sword, a “Strike” button for the owner, and +1 to armor class while the weapon is with them.
kind.name: Type the name “Weapon” and press Enter.
kind.hint: “What it is” must say “item” — it already does.

param.say: Make “Strike” take off as many hit points as “Weapon damage”.
param.hint: Until the button step, “Problems” will say that nobody passes “Weapon damage” — that is as it should be.
param.more: Open “Strike” and in “What comes in” press “+ another”.
param.moreHint: Can’t see “Strike”? It is in the “No block” group — expand it.
param.name: In “Name” type “Weapon damage” and press Enter.
param.expand: In the “success” branch click the collapsed fourth step, “Change”: it expands.
param.number: In the expanded step click the number in “How much”: it opens as a bar at the top and is selected.
param.pick: Start typing “damage” — the number will be replaced — and in the “from the record” group choose “Weapon damage”.
param.trap: The name has something extra, for example “New input”. Erase it so that it is exactly “Weapon damage”.
param.result: “Strike” takes off as much as “Weapon damage”.

given.say: So that a weapon gives “Strike”, not everyone, on the “Sheet” tab in the “What it gives all sheets” section remove “Strike” with the cross.
given.kinds: Above the sheet press “blocks and sheet types”.
given.all: In “Sheets” press “all blocks”: the section is shown only on it.
given.remove: In “What it gives all sheets” remove “Strike” with the cross.
given.result: “Strike” is no longer on everyone: an item will give it.

button.say: Make “Weapon” give its owner the “Strike” button.
button.hint: The “Calls the effect” list has no effects that hang on the sheet — only buttons and callable effects.
button.add: Open “Weapon” and in “Buttons on the sheet” press “+ button”.
button.result: The “Strike” button is there. “Weapon” got the property “Weapon damage” by itself: its value on a sword goes into “Strike”.

modifier.lead: Under the button you can see what “Weapon” fills “Strike” with: “Weapon damage” is a sword's property. Who strikes and whom, the button does not ask: it is whoever pressed it, and the targets chosen at the table.
modifier.say: Make a weapon give +1 to armor class while its owner has it.
modifier.add: In “What every item of this type modifies” press “+ edits a field”.
modifier.result: While the owner has the weapon, armor class is +1.

problems.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There should be no errors.

armor.lead: The sword itself is created by the book author once the system is published: main screen → “Book author” → “Create a record” → “Weapon”. The book does not see the training copy. The last task has no hints.
armor.say: Create the item type “Armor” that edits “Armor class”.
armor.goal: there is an item type “Armor” with an edit of “Armor class”, and “Problems” shows no errors.
armor.hint: In the “books” panel press “+ into” under the “Gear” block: a new type is added. On the new type press “+ edits a field”.
